messages:
Zoe (PM): Need a final scope call for Private packaging: handoff behavior, upgrade consent, and who signs the rollback SLA. Quick takes?
Cal (Infra Eng): Recommend handshake-only for MVP. No full orchestration yet. Provide a simple CLI: `rw-handoff --token TKN --window 2026-05-01T02:00Z`.
Ivy (Field): Field note: customers require explicit IP-retain opt-in and an opt-out for auto-upgrade. Also want a short runbook for emergency rollback.
Marco (NetOps): We'll expose `network.preserve_ips` in the manifest. Caveat: cloud-hosted nodes may still get new host IPs; document both flows.
Leah (Legal): Legal needs consent schema that records whether customer permits route withdrawal. We'll produce a clause and require signed consent for auto actions.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: nightly-build-2026.03.14  smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:
Cal (Infra Eng): Upgrade flow proposal: preflight -> KV snapshot -> optional cordon -> apply upgrade -> healthchecks -> auto-rollback for infra-critical failures. Manual for network/config cases.
Ivy (Field): Pilot plan: pick one cloud and one on-prem customer. Acceptance: rollback completes within 20 minutes for infra-critical events and audit entries recorded.
Zoe (PM): Owners & dates: Legal consent draft (Leah) by 2026-04-05, Eng impl (Cal) by 2026-04-12, Field pilots (Ivy) start 2026-04-18. Freeze scope if no objections by EOD Mon.
Marco (NetOps): I'll draft the handshake API (token + ASN + CIDRs + window) and add validation: CIDR overlap check + ASN mismatch warning.
Leah (Legal): I'll post draft consent language today and include required retention of audit logs for 1 year.
Zoe (PM): Thanks — weekly sync until pilots complete. If anyone needs more time flag now.
